newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Medi-Ject reinstated as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Medi-Ject reinstated as buy.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Friday it reinitiated coverage of Medi-Ject Corp with a buy rating and a price target of $13 a share.

-- Rodman said initial sales of Medi-Ject's new disposable needle-free syringes were encouraging and a patent it received last month will help the company develop a smaller, less expensive needle-free injection system that uses a different power source.
-- Rodman also increased Medi-Ject's projected loss for 1997 to $0.18 a share from $0.15 to reflect a clearer picture of the initial uptake in product sales in 1997.
-- Medi-Ject develops needle-free drug injection systems.
-- Its shares were off 1-1/4 Friday at 4.
